acceptance_predicates.description: A mandatory bounded CI check rejects GitHub Web Flow/noreply identities and invalid signature, DCO, parent, reviewed-head, or reviewed-tree provenance on pull requests and main integrations.
The settings tool distinguishes structural schema validity from live account capability and performs no mutation when required capability evidence is unknown or insufficient.

The public user-owned repository uses a generally available active core ruleset whose strict required contexts include the portable provenance check, without falsely claiming an unavailable metadata rule.
Merge commit is the sole PR merge method, squash/rebase/auto-merge are disabled, web signoff is required, and main deletion/non-fast-forward updates are prevented.
Rejected, partial, ambiguous, duplicate, foreign, stale, or identity-mismatched settings operations fail closed without blind retry or unrelated mutation.
Independent exact-head technical review is mandatory while same-account GitHub approval remains sufficient for development integration.

definition_of_done: Focused hostile provenance and capability/settings suites plus full project quality/privacy checks pass at the exact reviewed head.
An independent worker approves the exact candidate commit and tree; the signed DCO local merge preserves that reviewed tree.
Every exact-main post-merge workflow, including portable provenance, reaches terminal success.
One bounded live apply succeeds and two consecutive normalized audits plus independent receipt review prove the complete supported contract.
AR-1722 records the external-settings blocker as cleared while retaining the separate AR-1747 Coordinator-vendor dependency.

inputs.description: Atomic HTTP 422 rejection receipt and two unchanged-state audits from AR-1746.
docs/MERGE_INTEGRITY.md, merge_pr.py, repository_settings.py, workflows, and existing signature/DCO policy.
Bounded repository identity, owner type, visibility, plan/capability evidence, official schema, and normalized live ruleset state.

outputs.description: Portable required workflow and bounded verifier with hostile fixtures.
Reviewed settings auditor/apply path with safe field-level diagnostics and no unsupported metadata mutation.
Privacy-safe exact-identity pre/post audits, CI/run identities, and independent review evidence.

gates.description: Signature, DCO, Web Flow, parent/tree, PR-association, pagination, API-failure, and injection fixtures fail closed.
Public user-owned Free, supported Enterprise organization, unknown capability, malformed/hostile 422, no-POST, and no-partial-mutation cases behave exactly as specified.
A separate technical worker approves the exact candidate head/tree and later the live privacy-safe receipt.
All exact-main workflows pass at the immutable signed merge SHA.
Two consecutive normalized audits observe the complete supported settings and required-core-ruleset contract.
